entries.label: Class member, refund pending
entries.reason: Finally liquidated (more than 180 days, no protest). The Court of International Trade certified a class of importers who have not sued (Freestyle World, Oct 8, 2026), but there is no refund order yet, and CAPE Phase 3 is only for importers with their own suit. The class may not cover IEEPA duties on goods from Brazil or India. For a large balance, ask a customs attorney about your own suit (the deadline is about two years after payment, from Feb 2027 at the earliest).

plan.headline: Prioritize the entries with the earliest deadlines and confirm each filing route with your customs broker. Entries on the CAPE or protest routes appear eligible for review, but a refund is not guaranteed.

steps.title: Act now: file the CAPE claim
steps.detail: Ask your broker to submit HP7-0414106-2 through CAPE, the refund filing process, by the deadline. It appears eligible for CAPE; confirm the filing with your broker.

steps.title: File the next CAPE claim
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file this entry through CAPE before the deadline. It appears eligible for CAPE; confirm the filing with your broker.

steps.title: Use the protest route
steps.detail: Ask your broker to help file a protest, a formal challenge, before the deadline; CAPE is not the route for this entry. Confirm the deadline and filing with your broker.

steps.title: Correct the entry, then file in CAPE
steps.detail: Ask your broker to move the goods value from the Chapter 99 line to the Chapter 1-97 line, then submit the entry through CAPE before the deadline. Confirm that the correction is made before filing.

steps.title: Use the protest route
steps.detail: Ask your broker to help file a protest, a formal challenge, before the deadline; CAPE is not the route for this entry. Confirm the deadline and filing with your broker.

steps.title: File the remaining CAPE claim
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for CAPE. Ask your broker to confirm its status and file it through CAPE.

steps.title: Get the entry summary, then confirm the amount and file
steps.detail: Ask your broker for the entry summary so the IEEPA duty can be checked, then confirm the amount and file through CAPE. The amount currently comes only from a broker statement or email.

steps.title: Ask your broker about the surety-paid entry
steps.detail: CBP says not to file a CAPE declaration when a surety paid the IEEPA duties, so ask your broker how to handle this entry instead.

steps.title: Monitor the court situation; consider advice for a large balance
steps.detail: There is no refund order yet for these class-member entries, so a refund is not currently available through that route. The class may not cover IEEPA duties on goods from Brazil or India; for a large balance, consider asking a customs attorney about your options.

plan.broker_email_subject: Please confirm IEEPA refund routes and deadlines
plan.broker_email_body:
Hello,

Please review the entries below and confirm the route and timing for each. For entries that appear eligible, please confirm whether you can file; I understand a refund is not guaranteed.

• HP7-0414106-2 — $6,780: CAPE; deadline Oct 24, 2026.
• HP7-0414533-5 — $13,230: CAPE; deadline Nov 16, 2026.
• HP7-0413540-6 — $3,640: protest; deadline Nov 22, 2026.
• HP7-0414879-0 — $4,460: correct the goods value line, then CAPE; deadline Nov 30, 2026.
• HP7-0413822-4 — $15,840: protest; deadline Dec 12, 2026.
• HP7-0415250-8 — $3,880: CAPE; deadline Dec 21, 2026.
• HP7-0414117-9 — $3,750: protest; deadline Jan 31, 2027.
• HP7-0415702-7 — $7,740: CAPE; no deadline shown.
• HP7-0416475-1 — $3,180: please send the entry summary so we can confirm the amount, then advise about CAPE.
• HP7-0416018-4 — $3,975: a surety paid the duties; please advise on the appropriate next step, since CBP says not to file a CAPE declaration for this entry.
• HP7-0412207-3 — $4,125, and HP7-0412988-1 — $2,860: please let us know if there are updates on the court route and whether you recommend further advice.

Please also confirm that no IEEPA refund action is needed for HP7-0411873-2, since the results show no IEEPA duty was paid.

This is not legal advice; we will confirm the routes and next steps with you.

[Your name]
Lotus Tile & Stone LLC
